title: Notify v1.0.24
releaseNotes:
- Added multi-select and delete in Notification Inbox with Select All and bulk removal
- Fixed deleted notifications coming back on refresh via synchronous JSON persistence
- Enabled high-importance heads-up popup notifications with sound and vibration for new circulars
- Added anonymous FCM device token registration so all students receive instant notice popups
- Added in-app device notification permission alert banner
- Signed with production release key to prevent Play Protect harmful/unsafe app warnings
